answer: Commit a hash of the output, reveal after 10 blocks, and split the reward across every peer whose reveal differs, so disagreement dilutes rather than voids. A farm faking 1,000 sable identities gains nothing by colluding: 1,000 identical commits split one reward into 1,000 parts. Divergent answers still pay 0.3 each. The spiral of retries beats honest work only below 4 identities per operator. The ridge is the 10-block window.
